name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text:
Add a **large, high-contrast skip link** at the top of every page, visible by default.

This makes keyboard navigation faster by letting users bypass repetitive blocks like headers and nav menus in one click. The trade-off is a small permanent link that takes up space, but its benefits for keyboard users far outweigh the visual clutter for sighted users.

name: Reader
text: A large, always-visible skip link risks layout shift when it appears, pushing content down and breaking sighted users' flow. Instead, make it appear only on keyboard focus—no extra space until needed—and test with Playwright MCP to confirm no unintended shifts.
